title.value: AB 652, Friedman. Product safety: juvenile products: chemicals: perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances.
title.provenance: AB 652, Friedman.  Product  safety:  juvenile  products:  chemicals: perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances.

location.provenance: The people of the State of California do enact as follows:

date.provenance: [Approved by Governor October 5, 2021. Filed with Secretary of State October 5, 2021.]

pfas_definition.provenance: 'Perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances' or 'PFAS' means a  class  of  fluorinated  organic  chemicals  containing  at  least  one  fully fluorinated carbon atom.

type.provenance: On and after July 1, 2023, a person, including, but not limited to, a manufacturer, shall not sell or distribute in commerce in this state any new, not previously owned, juvenile product that contains regulated PFAS chemicals.

value: children's electronic product (e.g., personal computer, audio and video equipment, calculator, wireless phone, game console, handheld device incorporating a video screen, or associated peripheral such as mouse, keyboard, power supply unit, or power cord)
internal component of a juvenile product that would not come into direct contact with a child's skin or mouth during reasonably foreseeable use and abuse of the product
exceptions.provenance: A juvenile product does not include any of the following: (A)  A  children's  electronic  product,  including,  but not limited to,  a personal computer, audio and video equipment, calculator, wireless phone, game  console,  handheld  device  incorporating  a  video  screen,  or any associated peripheral such as a mouse, keyboard, power supply unit, or power cord. (B)  A medical device. (C)  An internal component of a juvenile product that would not come into direct contact with a child's skin or mouth during reasonably foreseeable use and abuse of the product. (D)  An adult mattress.
